ISA 401 Midwest AirBnB

Ask a question in plain English, get the SQL and a table back

A twelve-line querychat app built in ISA 401 (Miami University) on the job postings that ChatISA Job Scout collected. It is the starting point for Assignment 05, where you rebuild it on the Airbnb data, deploy it to Render from your GitHub repository, and then improve it.

Live app: (paste your Render URL here once it is deployed, for example https://midwest-airbnb-chat-xr51.onrender.com)

Example Questions:

1. Which Columbus neighbourhood has the priciest entire homes?

Question 1 answer
